svg.title: alsim-04-1-01: NMOS switch current I versus V1 (W/L = 10/1)
svg.desc: ngspice level 1; A held at 2.5 V, vB = 2.5 V + V1, bulk grounded; I flows from A through the channel to B

g.text: alsim-04-1-01: NMOS switch current I versus V1 (W/L = 10/1)
ngspice level 1; A held at 2.5 V, vB = 2.5 V + V1, bulk grounded; I flows from A through the channel to B
VG = 1 V: 0.05 mA at V1 = −2.5 V
VG = 2 V: 1.02 mA at V1 = −2.5 V
VG = 3 V: 3.20 mA at V1 = −2.5 V
VG = 4 V: 6.20 mA at V1 = −2.5 V
VG = 5 V: 9.23 mA at V1 = −2.5 V
VG = 4 V: −0.11 mA (0 for VG ≤ 3 V)
V1 < 0: B is the source, small VSB
V1 > 0: A is the source, VSB = 2.5 V
